original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Does research/e7-intersection-counters/engine.py, at batch size 16, return the same 64-word set as the weight-at-most-16 words of this E6 7-generator basis, with support hash ad4a1d101774e6c2da40cde3d097d39aa56ee5668dcdca858513c5fec3578215?
scope_change_reason: The replay-runtime card asks for a measured speedup that keeps coverage. Priority revision 8 says faster output is equivalent coverage only after the sets are compared. The merged intersection-counter package times the complete E7 consumer and leaves other codes outside its claim. The predecessor E6 4-frame comparison binds low_weight_words and leaves this engine unrun. This package answers that set question on the pinned 7-generator basis at batch size 16. It records no timing and leaves the selected conditional exponent unchanged.
bottleneck_link: Decoder and deletion certificates can reuse a faster iterator only when that iterator still returns every low-weight word of the code being certified. This comparison binds the opt-in intersection-counter engine to the E6 4-frame support set. It does not change a supplier bill or the selected conditional exponent.
stop_rule: Stop after one set comparison of engine.py at batch size 16 against the literal span of this kernel. Do not time the engine, rerun the 27-dimensional E7 census, or build a D6 or P112 frame code.
evidence: On the 36 E6 lines stored as the A2 complement, the 135 orthogonal 4-frames have F2 incidence rank 29. The kernel basis with identity on free coordinates (0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 20) is the seven integers (6591703721, 6306835114, 13904919564, 45813124144, 28344004800, 68452089600, 68718428160). Its 128 codewords include zero and 63 weight-16 words, and no lighter nonzero word. The SHA256 of those 63 words, as a default JSON list, is ad4a1d101774e6c2da40cde3d097d39aa56ee5668dcdca858513c5fec3578215. At batch size 16 the intersection-counter stream is those 64 words with no duplicate yield. Removing the least positive word changes the set and the hash. A repeated generator is rejected with the engine message dependent generators.
author: unpaidmoon

open_questions.question: Does the same set equality hold at another legal batch size, for example 8?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Batch size changes the engine's lane split. Equality at batch size 16 does not by itself decide a smaller batch.
open_questions.first_step: Rerun this comparison with batch_bits set to 8 and the same seven generators, weight bound 16, and support hash.
open_questions.blocked_by: Nothing mathematical blocks that rerun. This package stops after batch size 16, so batch size 8 has not been compared.

open_questions.question: Can this opt-in engine be installed at a caller that consumes the E6 4-frame code, with regenerated source pins?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Set equality on one code leaves production replacement and its dependent pins untouched.
open_questions.first_step: Name one caller boundary and perform the installation and source-bound compatibility check already stated by research/e7-intersection-counters.
open_questions.blocked_by: That package records production installation as a separate step. This comparison does not regenerate consumer pins.
